newsitem.title: HONG KONG: GITIC says HK IPO, listing plan on schedule.
newsitem.headline: GITIC says HK IPO, listing plan on schedule.

text.p: Guangdong provincial government-backed GITIC Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday its Hong Kong initial public offering (IPO) of shares and listing plan will proceed on schedule.
Market speculation spread widely on Tuesday that the plan had hit a snag and that the company possibly would call off its listing plan.

"(We) wish to advise the investing public that the above issue will proceed in accordance with the timetable set out in the company's prospectus dated 14th March, 1997," the company said in a statement issued through the stock exchange.
"Accordingly the issue will close as planned at 12:00 noon (0400 GMT) on Thursday, 20th March, 1997," it said.

GITIC Enterprises is indirectly controlled by the Guangdong provincial goverment's investment arm, Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp (GITIC), which had total assets of about 20.56 billion yuan as at the end of 1995.
GITIC Enterprises imports and sells construction materials in Hong Kong and China, and also owns the second floor of a shopping mall at GITIC Plaza in Guangzhou.
